\usepackage{fontspec}

% Global font defaults. The flagship build uses TeX-distributed fonts so the

% depending on host operating-system font availability.
\defaultfontfeatures{Ligatures=TeX}

\setmainfont{TeX Gyre Termes}

% --- Languages (Polyglossia) ------------------

\usepackage{polyglossia}

% The English master build is the default when no translation shell overrides
% \ocdefaultlanguage before loading this shared preamble.
\providecommand{\ocdefaultlanguage}{english}
\setdefaultlanguage{\ocdefaultlanguage}
\setotherlanguages{english,german,russian}

% Support for Cyrillic if Russian text is used. The CMU Unicode fonts ship
% with MiKTeX/TeX Live and avoid falling back to Latin-only TeX Gyre faces.
\newfontfamily\cyrillicfont[
  UprightFont    = cmunrm.otf,
  BoldFont       = cmunbx.otf,
  ItalicFont     = cmunti.otf,
  BoldItalicFont = cmunbi.otf
]{cmunrm.otf}
\newfontfamily\cyrillicfontsf[
  UprightFont    = cmunss.otf,
  BoldFont       = cmunsx.otf,
  ItalicFont     = cmunso.otf,
  BoldItalicFont = cmunbxo.otf
]{cmunss.otf}
\newfontfamily\cyrillicfonttt[
  UprightFont    = cmuntt.otf,
  BoldFont       = cmuntb.otf,
  ItalicFont     = cmunit.otf,
  BoldItalicFont = cmunbto.otf
]{cmuntt.otf}

% --- OC Core: custom Greek macros (future-proof) ----
%
% LaTeX does not define macros such as \Alpha, \Beta, or \Chi.
% Define them once with \providecommand so that:
%   - current content, for example \Chi, compiles;
%   - later explicit redefinitions are not overwritten.

\providecommand{\Alpha}{\mathrm{A}}
\providecommand{\Beta}{\mathrm{B}}
\providecommand{\Epsilon}{\mathrm{E}}
\providecommand{\Zeta}{\mathrm{Z}}
\providecommand{\Eta}{\mathrm{H}}
\providecommand{\Iota}{\mathrm{I}}
\providecommand{\Kappa}{\mathrm{K}}
\providecommand{\Mu}{\mathrm{M}}
\providecommand{\Nu}{\mathrm{N}}
\providecommand{\Omicron}{\mathrm{O}}
\providecommand{\Rho}{\mathrm{P}}
\providecommand{\Tau}{\mathrm{T}}
\providecommand{\Chi}{\mathrm{X}}

% --- OC Core: operator macros -----------------

\DeclareMathOperator{\OmegaOp}{\Omega}
\DeclareMathOperator{\PsiOp}{\Psi}
\DeclareMathOperator{\PhiOp}{\Phi}
\DeclareMathOperator{\UOp}{U}
\DeclareMathOperator{\LambdaOp}{\Lambda}
\DeclareMathOperator{\ChiOp}{\Chi}

% --- OC editorial helpers ---------------------

\makeatletter
\newcommand{\occode}[1]{%
  \begingroup
  \small\ttfamily
  \edef\oc@detok{\detokenize{#1}}%
  \expandafter\seqsplit\expandafter{\oc@detok}%
  \endgroup
}
\makeatother
\newcommand{\ocvolumeblock}[2]{%
  \clearpage
  \phantomsection
  \addcontentsline{toc}{section}{#1}
  \thispagestyle{empty}
  \vspace*{\fill}
  \begin{center}
    {\Large\bfseries #1\par}
    \vspace{0.8cm}
    \begin{minipage}{0.78\textwidth}
      \RaggedRight
      #2
    \end{minipage}
  \end{center}
  \vspace*{\fill}
  \clearpage
}
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=0.2em, topsep=0.3em}
\newcolumntype{L}[1]{>{\RaggedRight\arraybackslash}p{#1}}
